source.operation: single scalar ASCII reading or error-queue response
source.transport: offline saved bytes, or the optional RS-232 helper scripts/keithley2000_session.py

data.raw_provenance: Real instrument captures, 2026-10-20, Keithley Model 2000 serial 0944865 over RS-232 9600 8N1: ~25.2 V DC on front INPUT HI/LO, and the same supply feeding a load through front AMPS/INPUT LO in series (~202 mA).

command_exercised_settings: NPLC 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10 on a fixed 10 V range (timing with autozero on and off)
REL reference 0.05 A, state on/off, and REFerence:ACQuire on open DCI
digital filter state/type/count (MOVing, REPeat, count 10) on open DCI

known_limitations: Hardware evidence covers DC voltage and DC current over RS-232 on one instrument only; all other functions and interfaces remain documented.
The parser accepts one ASCII scalar line and one error-queue line only; other error-queue codes require explicit error-queue mode.
Multi-reading, binary, and scanner responses are unsupported.
Automatic error-queue classification recognizes only documented sentinels; other error-queue lines require explicit error-queue mode.
Calibration count/date/due/lock were read, but calibration accuracy, adjustment, and drift are not inferred; fuse continuity and acquisition freshness are also not inferred.
With continuous initiation ON, :READ? queues -213,"Init ignored" and returns a continuous-acquisition value rather than a newly triggered reading.

Open-input and no-signal behaviour is recorded in assets/captures/open-inputs/: resistance, 4-wire, continuity, diode, and temperature overflow as +9.9E37, frequency/period report 0, and floating DCV autoranges to 100 mV with tens of millivolts of drift.

Error -213 has two verified causes: continuous initiation ON, and :INITiate while the instrument is not idle (armed BUS trigger). An armed trigger with a pending FETCh blocks the output queue and every later query times out; recovery observed with a device clear (0x03), exposed as `unblock`.

live_session_properties.pyserial: lazy import; --dry-run never opens the port
live_session_properties.framing: 8N1, no flow control, CR transmit, one response per query
guards: --allow-current also required when config selects CURR:DC/CURR:AC

tooling.port_lock: non-blocking exclusive flock; a second concurrent session is refused
